GBOGEB/ABACUS.why: Fast, reliable PR checks: syntax, smoke, restricted-term guard, dependency review. Full-red jobs (coverage, quality, security) stay out until their EVERRED roots close.

GBOGEB/CODEX.why: Lint, smoke, Bandit and the governance adversary pass on every PR. governance-gate (50% red) and semantic-validation stay out until triaged.

GBOGEB/cryoplant-project.why: Engineering-authority repo: verification, recurrence control and federation smoke on every PR.

GBOGEB/gg_MATH.why: Numerical kernels: first kernel and Monte-Carlo reference run on every PR.

GBOGEB/pipeline-automation-hub.why: Hosts the Code Purple review site. Keeps linear history and Copilot review from the existing ruleset, which currently targets no branch. GOGREEN required gate is the MACH-II compensating check for the solo-owner review waiver; it is below the 90% bar (9/12) only because it failed on true reds (#815, #820, #821). First-Pass Closure Gate / first-pass-closure is the trusted controller's head status (W305 R7), required so a red gate blocks the merge button; 1/12 recent merges had it green, so it blocks until receipts and exact-head Codex reviews are routine.

GBOGEB/Q_engineering_tools.why: Build and engineering-source smoke run on every PR.
